Global Thematic Partners Upped Its Stericycle (SRCL) Position; Security National Trust Co Decreased Its Stake in Jpmorgan Chase & Co (JPM) by $367,330 as Market Value Declined
June 24, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Global Thematic Partners Llc increased its stake in Stericycle Inc (SRCL) by 3.42% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Global Thematic Partners Llc bought 38,204 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.16 million shares of the basic industries company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $67.67 million, up from 1.12 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Global Thematic Partners Llc who had been investing in Stericycle Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.50B market cap company. The stock increased 1.73% or $1.09 during the last trading session, reaching $64.26. About 371,753 shares traded. Stericycle, Inc. (NASDAQ:SRCL) has declined 24.06% since June 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.63% the S&P500.
